label: Muse Video
notes: Meta's Muse Video via meta.ai. Assistant rewrites prompts before Muse sees them, so prompts need the pass-through wrapper. Max 4 shots per clip, 2 s minimum per shot (field notes, owner-confirmed).
source: Field-tested by owner via meta.ai (Muse), confirmed host; shot/word limits from prompt-sheet conventions — not vendor docs.

label: Seedance 2.5
notes: BytePlus Seedance 2.5 via Dreamina/Jimeng/BytePlus console. Writes consecutive time ranges with cut events at time points; duration set on the generation page, not in the prompt.
source: Seedance 2.5 prompt guide (BytePlus ModelArk) + G9c built-in hosts (owner-confirmed).

label: Kling
notes: Kling 4.0 text-to-video: prompt fewer than 8,000 tokens; positive and negative descriptions supported; Omni Reference up to 10 keyframe/image inputs; native video up to 30 s.

label: MiniMax Hailuo
notes: MiniMax Hailuo 02 text-to-video: prompt up to 2,000 characters; 6 s or 10 s clips; multimodal input supports one image and one video reference.

label: Google Veo
notes: Google Veo (Veo 2/Veo 3). Prompt length, reference slots and durations not yet sourced from vendor docs.
source: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/video/generate-videos-from-text (Google Cloud Veo docs) — no numeric limits published in the pages reviewed.

label: Runway
notes: Runway Gen-3/Gen-4. 5 s and 10 s base generations reported by third-party coverage; the vendor's own prompting guide was retired (July 2026) and no numeric prompt limit or duration is sourced from vendor docs.
source: https://runway.com/research/introducing-gen-3-alpha (Runway Gen-3 Alpha); durations reported by third-party coverage, not vendor docs.
